statement.zh-TW: 能依序說出五層利益（營業毛利、營業利益、經常利益、稅前淨利、本期淨利），以及每一層之間加上或扣除的項目
statement.en: Name the five profit levels in order (gross profit, operating profit, ordinary profit, profit before tax, profit for the period) and say what is added or deducted between each pair

text.zh-TW: 以為營業毛利已經扣掉人事與運費等銷管費用
text.en: Thinking gross profit is already after staff, delivery and other distribution costs and administrative expenses

text.zh-TW: 把利息費用算進營業利益之前的費用
text.en: Deducting interest expense before operating profit

text.zh-TW: 以為稅前淨利已經扣掉所得稅
text.en: Thinking profit before tax is already after income tax

statement.zh-TW: 能把收入、成本、費用與業外項目放到損益表正確的列，並分辨費用與資產的差別
statement.en: Place revenue, cost of sales, expenses and non-operating items on the right lines of the income statement, and tell an expense from an asset

text.zh-TW: 把進貨當成當期的費用，而不是存貨
text.en: Treating a purchase of goods as this period's expense rather than inventory

text.zh-TW: 把買設備的錢當成當期的費用
text.en: Treating the cost of equipment as this period's expense

text.zh-TW: 把利息費用放進銷管費用
text.en: Putting interest expense among distribution costs and administrative expenses

statement.zh-TW: 能用期初存貨、本期進貨與期末存貨說明營業成本怎麼算，並說出期末存貨與資產負債表的連動
statement.en: Use opening inventory, purchases and closing inventory to explain how cost of sales is worked out, and say how closing inventory links to the balance sheet

text.zh-TW: 以為本期進貨多少，營業成本就是多少
text.en: Thinking cost of sales simply equals this period's purchases

text.zh-TW: 以為期末沒賣完的存貨也算進這期的成本
text.en: Thinking unsold closing inventory is also part of this period's cost

text.zh-TW: 以為進貨會讓營業毛利下降
text.en: Thinking that buying goods lowers gross profit

statement.zh-TW: 能判斷一筆收益或支出屬於本業還是業外、經常還是一次性，以及收入該在哪一期認列
statement.en: Judge whether an item of income or expense belongs to the core business or outside it, whether it is recurring or one-off, and in which period revenue should be recognised

text.zh-TW: 以為公司收到的任何收益都算營業收入
text.en: Thinking any income the company receives counts as revenue

text.zh-TW: 把一次性的收益當成每年都會有的經營成果
text.en: Treating a one-off gain as a recurring result of the business

text.zh-TW: 把客戶預付的錢當成已經賺到的收入
text.en: Treating money received in advance from customers as revenue already earned
